comment: Example policy. Every item is one expression evaluated on the endpoint. 'applicability' answers a yes/no question; 'inventory' collects a value. Same engine, same syntax.

items.comment: The canonical shape: installed, and older than the fixed version. Guarded so a missing Chrome is false, not an error.

Compliance is the same primitive as patch applicability -- that is the entire difference. Note the explicit namespace: Win32_EncryptableVolume is NOT in root/cimv2, and this needs admin. Without both, the item reports an error, which is correct: a check that could not run is not a clean bill of health.
items.relevance: cim_value("SELECT ProtectionStatus FROM Win32_EncryptableVolume WHERE DriveLetter='C:'", "ProtectionStatus", "root/cimv2/Security/MicrosoftVolumeEncryption") != "1"

items.comment: Staged rollout is not a second targeting mechanism -- it is an ordinary relevance expression. Stable per-machine bucket derived from agent_id.
